sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT, "principalInvestigator" TEXT, "location" TEXT, "timeZone" TEXT, "startDate" TEXT, "endDate" TEXT, "created" TEXT, "lastAccessed" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personnel" ("uuid" TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT, "initial" TEXT, "email" TEXT, "phone" TEXT, "affiliation" TEXT, "role" TEXT, "currentFieldNumber" INTEGER, "notes" TEXT, "photoPath" TEXT, "isRegisterField" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("primaryId" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "secondaryId" TEXT, "category" TEXT, "tag" TEXT, "taken" TEXT, "camera" TEXT, "lenses" TEXT, "additionalExif" TEXT, "personnelId" TEXT, "fileName" TEXT, "caption" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(personnelId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "siteID" TEXT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "leadStaffId" TEXT, "siteType" TEXT, "country" TEXT, "stateProvince" TEXT, "county" TEXT, "municipality" TEXT, "mediaID" TEXT, "locality" TEXT, "remark" TEXT, "habitatType" TEXT, "habitatCondition" TEXT, "habitatDescription" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(mediaID)REFERENCES media(primaryId), FOREIGN KEY(leadStaffId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coordinate" ("id" INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "nameId" TEXT, "decimalLatitude" REAL, "decimalLongitude" REAL, "elevationInMeter" REAL, "datum" TEXT, "uncertaintyInMeters" INTEGER, "gpsUnit" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "siteID" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(siteID)REFERENCES site(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collEvent" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "idSuffix" TEXT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "startDate" TEXT, "startTime" TEXT, "endDate" TEXT, "endTime" TEXT, "primaryCollMethod" TEXT, "collMethodNotes" TEXT, "siteID" INTEGER REFERENCES site(id), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather" ("eventID" INTEGER, "lowestDayTempC" REAL, "highestDayTempC" REAL, "lowestNightTempC" REAL, "highestNightTempC" REAL, "averageHumidity" REAL, "dewPointTemp" REAL, "sunriseTime" TEXT, "sunsetTime" TEXT, "moonPhase" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collPersonnel" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "eventID" INTEGER, "personnelId" TEXT, "name" TEXT, "role" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id), FOREIGN KEY(personnelId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collEffort" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "eventID" INTEGER, "method" TEXT, "brand" TEXT, "count" INTEGER, "size" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "narrative" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "date" TEXT, "time" TEXT, "siteID" INTEGER, "writerId" TEXT, "narrative" TEXT, "mediaID" INTEGER REFERENCES media(primaryId), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(siteID)REFERENCES site(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "narrativeMedia" ("narrativeId" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(narrativeId)REFERENCES narrative(id), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "siteMedia" ("siteId" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(siteId)REFERENCES site(id), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "taxonomy" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "taxonClass" TEXT, "taxonOrder" TEXT, "taxonFamily" TEXT, "genus" TEXT, "specificEpithet" TEXT, "authors" TEXT, "commonName" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "citesStatus" TEXT, "redListCategory" TEXT, "countryStatus" TEXT, "sortingOrder" INTEGER, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimen" ("uuid" TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "projectUuid" TEXT, "speciesID" INTEGER, "iDConfidence" INTEGER, "iDMethod" TEXT, "taxonGroup" TEXT, "condition" TEXT, "prepDate" TEXT, "prepTime" TEXT, "collectionDate" TEXT, "collectionTime" TEXT, "captureDate" TEXT, "isRelativeTime" INTEGER, "captureTime" TEXT, "relativeCaptureTime" TEXT, "trapType" TEXT, "methodID" TEXT, "coordinateID" INTEGER, "catalogerID" TEXT, "fieldNumber" INTEGER, "projectFieldNumber" INTEGER, "collEventID" INTEGER, "isMultipleCollector" INTEGER, "collPersonnelID" INTEGER, "collMethodID" INTEGER, "museumID" TEXT, "preparatorID" TEXT REFERENCES personnel(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(catalogerID)REFERENCES personnel(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(collPersonnelID)REFERENCES collPersonnel(id), FOREIGN KEY(collMethodID)REFERENCES collEffort(id), FOREIGN KEY(speciesID)REFERENCES taxonomy(id), FOREIGN KEY(collEventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimenMedia" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "associatedData" ("primaryId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "specimenUuid" TEXT, "name" TEXT, "type" TEXT, "date" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "url" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personnelList" ("projectUuid" TEXT, "personnelUuid" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(personnelUuid)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mammalMeasurement" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "showBatFields" INTEGER, "totalLength" REAL, "tailLength" REAL, "hindFootLength" REAL, "earLength" REAL, "forearm" REAL, "tibia" REAL, "showEchoFields" INTEGER, "echolocation" INTEGER, "frequencyMax" REAL, "frequencyMin" REAL, "frequencyAtMaxEnergy" REAL, "duration" REAL, "weight" REAL, "accuracy" TEXT, "accuracySpecify" TEXT, "sex" INTEGER, "age" INTEGER, "testisPosition" INTEGER, "testisLength" REAL, "testisWidth" REAL, "epididymisAppearance" INTEGER, "reproductiveStage" INTEGER, "leftPlacentalScars" INTEGER, "rightPlacentalScars" INTEGER, "mammaeCondition" INTEGER, "mammaeInguinalCount" INTEGER, "mammaeAxillaryCount" INTEGER, "mammaeAbdominalCount" INTEGER, "vaginaOpening" INTEGER, "pubicSymphysis" INTEGER, "embryoLeftCount" INTEGER, "embryoRightCount" INTEGER, "embryoCR" INTEGER, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "avianMeasurement" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" REAL, "wingspan" REAL, "irisColor" TEXT, "irisHex" TEXT, "billColor" TEXT, "billHex" TEXT, "footColor" TEXT, "footHex" TEXT, "tarsusColor" TEXT, "tarsusHex" TEXT, "sex" INTEGER, "broodPatch" INTEGER, "skullOssification" INTEGER, "hasBursa" INTEGER, "bursaWidth" REAL, "bursaLength" REAL, "fat" INTEGER, "stomachContent" TEXT, "testisLength" REAL, "testisWidth" REAL, "testisRemark" TEXT, "ovaryLength" REAL, "ovaryWidth" REAL, "oviductWidth" REAL, "ovaryAppearance" INTEGER, "firstOvaSize" REAL, "secondOvaSize" REAL, "thirdOvaSize" REAL, "oviductAppearance" INTEGER, "ovaryRemark" TEXT, "wingIsMolt" INTEGER, "wingMolt" TEXT, "tailIsMolt" INTEGER, "tailMolt" TEXT, "bodyMolt" INTEGER, "moltRemark" TEXT, "specimenRemark" TEXT, "habitatRemark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "herpMeasurement" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "sex" INTEGER, "age" INTEGER, "weight" REAL, "svl" REAL, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimenPart" ("id" INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "specimenUuid" TEXT, "personnelId" TEXT, "tissueID" TEXT, "barcodeID" TEXT, "type" TEXT, "count" TEXT, "treatment" TEXT, "additionalTreatment" TEXT, "dateTaken" TEXT, "timeTaken" TEXT, "pmi" TEXT, "museumPermanent" TEXT, "museumLoan" TEXT, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(personnelId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS specimen_project_species_idx ON specimen (projectUuid, speciesID)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS specimen_project_event_idx ON specimen (projectUuid, collEventID)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS site_project_idx ON site (projectUuid)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS coordinate_site_idx ON coordinate (siteID)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS specimen_project_coordinate_idx ON specimen (projectUuid, coordinateID)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS coll_event_project_site_idx ON collEvent (projectUuid, siteID)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS specimen_part_specimen_idx ON specimenPart (specimenUuid)
